<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 页面路径：store/index.js</span>
import { createStore } <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">vuex</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> store =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> createStore({
    state:{</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">存放状态</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">xcx_zt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>,<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">程序是否在线</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">m_zt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>,<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">设备是否在线</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">m_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">''</span>,<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">设备ID</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    },
    mutations: {
        chang_xcx_zt(state, n) {
            state.xcx_zt </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> n
        },
        chang_m_zt(state, n) {
            state.m_zt </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> n
        },
        chang_m_id(state, n) {
            state.m_id </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> n
        },
    }
})

export </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span> store</pre>

<pre>import mqtt <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mqtt/dist/mqtt.min</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import store </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@/store/index.js</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> MQTT 配置（根据实际服务端修改）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> MQTT_CONFIG =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 不同端的连接协议：
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> H5: ws:</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">xxx:8083/mqtt 或 wss:</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">xxx:8084/mqtt
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 微信小程序: wxs:</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">xxx:8084/mqtt（需配置域名白名单）
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> App: tcp:</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">xxx:1883（需配置网络权限）</span>
    host: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">wxs://xxx:8084/mqtt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> host: 'ws:</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">xxx:8083/mqtt', </span>
    clientId: `wine-${Math.random().toString(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">16</span>).substr(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span>)}`, <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 唯一客户端ID</span>
    username: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">zyw</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 服务端认证用户名（无则留空）</span>
    password: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">zyw123456</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 服务端认证密码（无则留空）</span>
    keepalive: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">60</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 心跳间隔（秒）</span>
    reconnectPeriod: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5000</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 重连间隔（毫秒）</span>
    clean: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 清除会话（true：断开后不保留订阅）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 全局 MQTT 客户端实例</span>
let client = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 消息回调函数（供页面监听）</span>
let messageCallback = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
 * 连接 MQTT 服务器
 * @param {Function} callback 消息接收回调 (topic, message) =&gt; {}
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
export function connectMQTT(callback) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 保存消息回调</span>
    messageCallback =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> callback

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 已连接则直接返回</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (client &amp;&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> client.connected){
        store.commit(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">chang_xcx_zt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>)<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">在线</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    } 

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建连接</span>
    client =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> mqtt.connect(MQTT_CONFIG.host, {
        clientId: MQTT_CONFIG.clientId,
        username: MQTT_CONFIG.username,
        password: MQTT_CONFIG.password,
        keepalive: MQTT_CONFIG.keepalive,
        reconnectPeriod: MQTT_CONFIG.reconnectPeriod,
        clean: MQTT_CONFIG.clean
    })

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 连接成功回调</span>
    client.on(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">connect</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        console.log(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">MQTT 连接成功：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, MQTT_CONFIG.clientId);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(MQTT_CONFIG.clientId){
            store.commit(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">chang_xcx_zt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>)<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">在线</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (messageCallback) {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> p_obj=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{};
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> p_data=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{};
                
                p_data.keyword</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">connect</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                p_data.clientId</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">MQTT_CONFIG.clientId;
                p_data.msg</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">MQTT 连接成功</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                
                p_obj.code</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                p_obj.data</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">p_data;
                messageCallback(p_obj) </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 转字符串便于处理</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
        }
    })

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 接收消息回调</span>
    client.on(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">message</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, (topic, message) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        console.log(`收到消息1：topic</span>=${topic}, message=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">${message.toString()}`)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (messageCallback) {
            messageCallback(topic, message.toString()) </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 转字符串便于处理</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
    })

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 连接错误回调</span>
    client.on(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">error</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, (error) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        console.error(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">MQTT 连接错误：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, error)
        store.commit(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">chang_xcx_zt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>)<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">离线</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (messageCallback) {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> p_obj=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{};
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> p_data=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{};
            p_data.keyword</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">error</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            p_data.error</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">error;
            p_data.msg</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">MQTT 连接错误</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            
            p_obj.code</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            p_obj.data</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">p_data;
            messageCallback(p_obj) </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 转字符串便于处理</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
        
    })

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 断开连接回调</span>
    client.on(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">close</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {

        store.commit(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">chang_xcx_zt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>)<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">离线</span>

        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (messageCallback) {

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> p_data=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{};

            p_obj.code</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
    })

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 重连回调</span>

        store.commit(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">chang_xcx_zt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>)<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">离线</span>

            messageCallback(p_obj) </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 转字符串便于处理</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
    })
}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
 * 断开 MQTT 连接
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
export function disconnectMQTT(callback) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (client &amp;&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> client.connected) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 保存消息回调</span>
        messageCallback =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> callback
        client.end()
        client </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        console.log(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">MQTT 主动断开连接</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        store.commit(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">chang_xcx_zt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>)<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">离线</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (messageCallback) {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> p_obj=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{};
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> p_data=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{};
            p_data.keyword</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">disconnect</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            p_data.msg</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">MQTT 主动断开连接</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            
            p_obj.code</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            p_obj.data</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">p_data;
            messageCallback(p_obj) </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 转字符串便于处理</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
        
    }
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
 * 订阅 MQTT 主题
 * @param {String|Array} topic 主题（单个字符串或数组）
 * @param {Number} qos 服务质量（0/1/2，默认0）
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
export function subscribeMQTT(topic, qos </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!client || !<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">client.connected) {
    console.error(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">MQTT 未连接，无法订阅</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  }
  client.subscribe(topic, { qos }, (error) </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (error) {
      console.error(`订阅主题 ${topic} 失败：`, error)
    } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
      console.log(`订阅主题 ${topic} 成功`)
    }
  })
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
 * 发布 MQTT 消息
 * @param {String} topic 主题
 * @param {String|Object} message 消息内容（对象会转为JSON字符串）
 * @param {Number} qos 服务质量（0/1/2，默认0）
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
export function publishMQTT(topic, message, qos </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!client || !<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">client.connected) {
    console.error(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">MQTT 未连接，无法发布消息</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  }
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 统一转为字符串</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> msg = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span> message === <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">object</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> ?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> JSON.stringify(message) : message
  client.publish(topic, msg, { qos }, (error) </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (error) {
      console.error(`发布消息到 ${topic} 失败：`, error)
    } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
      console.log(`发布消息到 ${topic} 成功：`, msg)
    }
  })
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
 * 取消订阅 MQTT 主题
 * @param {String|Array} topic 主题（单个字符串或数组）
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
export function unsubscribeMQTT(topic) {
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!client || !<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">client.connected) {
    console.error(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">MQTT 未连接，无法取消订阅</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  }
  client.unsubscribe(topic, (error) </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (error) {
      console.error(`取消订阅 ${topic} 失败：`, error)
    } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
      console.log(`取消订阅 ${topic} 成功`)
    }
  })
}

                publishMQTT(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/uni-app/test</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, {

                    time: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Date().toLocaleString()
                })
            },
        
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 断开连接</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            disconnect() {

                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     scanType: ['qrCode'], </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">只支持二维码
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     onlyFromCamera: true,
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     success: function(res) {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">         console.log('条码类型：' + res.scanType);
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">         console.log('条码内容：' + res.result);
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     }
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> });</span>
                }<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(id==<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">){
                    uni.switchTab({
                        url:</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/pages/my/index</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                    })
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
</span>&lt;/script&gt;
